contracts.method_note: Same evidence-ID method, frozen cohort, templates and schema contracts. Checkpoint instrumentation, retries/budgets and recorded code versions differ from NeMo. Stage 2 bodies include each model-specific stage 1 hypothesis, so full request bodies are not asserted identical.

interpretation: GPT produces 12 more reference-correct automatic answers than NeMo, but also 15 more incorrect automatic answers.
Selective accuracy is conditional on different accepted sets; use the common accepted set and correct automatic yield too.
Qwen partial full-cohort scores combine availability and semantics. Missing rows are separately reported; no clean semantic ranking.
General-approval conflicts with historical labels are not resolved by this analysis; no labels were changed.
Only one screening fold with 23 contribution clusters; cluster bootstrap intervals, not independent-pair inference.
GPT is promising for retrospective evaluation on other folds, not established superior or deployment-ready. No new runs initiated.
Before any later Qwen rerun, investigate the external LiteLLM/provider serving path and consider a circuit breaker; no serving configuration edited.
